build_backward_cpp: build the backward-cpp library using CMake with configurable stack walking and details options
package_backward_cpp: package the backward-cpp header and compiled libraries into a Conan package for distribution
configure_stack_walking: configure backward-cpp stack walking to use unwind or backtrace via Conan options
configure_stack_details: configure backward-cpp stack details to use auto detect, backtrace symbol, dw, or bfd
review_conanfile_options: review the BackwardCpp Conan recipe options for shared library and stack walking configuration
